run_pipeline_generate_image_embeddings: run the StableCascadePriorPipeline to generate image embeddings from a text prompt
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings with optional negative prompt and classifier-free guidance
encode_image_clip_embeddings: encode PIL images into CLIP image embeddings using the feature extractor and image encoder
prepare_latents_denoising: prepare initial noisy latents for the Stable Cascade prior denoising loop
validate_pipeline_inputs: validate pipeline inputs including prompts, embeddings, images, and negative prompts for correctness
